tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa skya bka' 'bum dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag bsam 'phel dbang rgyal bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / bsam brjod spros kun dbyings su zhi ba kun khyab lha lam rang bzhin mdangs/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi mnga' bdag mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis legs gtams nas/ /mchog skye bzo yi sgyu 'phrul gar gyis lhun grub 'dod pa 'jo mkhas pa/ /byang chub dam pa mngon gyur thub chen bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bsten/ /'khrul pa'i grogs bral bden pa'i gnyen can pad 'dab ljags las lhung ba yi/ /rdo rje'i lung gis 'jug ngogs gsal byas gang de'i phrin las pho nya zhes/ /snyigs dus lus can gcong nad zug rngu cig car 'byin pa'i tshe 'dzin mkhan/ /'dzam gling mdzes byed gsum gnyis rgyan sogs byang chub snying po'i grogs su bsten/ /'phags yul chu gter rba rlabs bdo yang snying stobs gru chen la brten nas/ /lhag bsam ded dpon dam pa'i 'khor du lus srog rgyang du 'phen mdzad de/ kha ba'i ljongs kyi snying gi mun pa ming gi gnas su 'jog byed mkhan/ /lo ka'i mig can bka' drin lci yang snying dbus khur du bsten par spro/ /bka' bstan gangs can spo ngos las byung lo chen sman chab rnam bzhi las/ /legs byung bsod nams sa dkar gshin par mdo sngags rig pa'i ljon bzang brtas/ /lung rigs man ngag bcud kyis gtams pa'i 'bras bzang skal ba mchog gi ngor/ /ji ltar blo yi ji snyed 'dod pa sbyin mkhas sa chen gong ma rgyal/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i dbang lha'i phrag las legs thon mkhyen pa'i tsha zer rgyas/ /pad dkar 'dzin pa'i sprin lam ngos su brtse chen dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa/ /lag na rdo rje'i rta bdun gyis drangs rgol ngan smag kun bcil mdzad pa'i/ /tshula~X ldan gling bzhi'i khrimasa~X gtsang gdul bya'i rab dkar rgyala~X mtshana~X bsgreng byed rgyal/ /rnam 'dren kun gyi thugs gzer g.yo bas snyigs dus sa bla'i sman ljongs su/

/ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol brtsen pas bdag 'dra'i dmu rgod gdug can rnams/ /gdon gyis brlams pa'i rig 'chol bsal nas 'khrul bral bstan pa'i nying khu yis/ /'tsho mdzad gangs can ris med bstan skyong bshes gnyen mchog rnams spyi bo'i rgyan/ /zhi bsil bdud rtsi'i klung gis bho ṭa yi/ /lus can dri bral bde bas yongs 'dzin mkhan/ /chu skyes lag gnas chos rgyal srong btsan dang*/ /mes dbon mdzangs blon rnams kyi bka' drin dran/ /'on kyang bsod nams dpung zhan snang byed dpal/ /chu lha'i phang du yib nas gangs ljongs kyi/ /lus can 'byung po'i tshogs kyis rtag gtses par/ /ye shes dam pa'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /de slad smon lam bzang pos 'phul byas nas/ /phrin las lo paṇa mchog las dam chos kyi/ /rab dkar spros kyang spyi mthun lus can smag /bsel byed rta ljang can gyis bsgrun pas stong*/ /phan bde'i rgyun mchog dam chos 'o ma'i bcud/ /gcig tu skyil mdzad sa chen gong ma zhes/ /rigs gsum 'phags chen phrin las zlos gar mkhan/ /gsung rab yang bsdur brgyud rim deng 'dir gleng*/ / zhes bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i gtam gyis sgo yangs por dbye bar byas nas 'dir/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag rigs gsum sems dpa' chen po'i phrin las kyi pho nya'i rnam 'phrul/ srid pa gsum gyi skye 'gro'i rtsa lag dam pa/ snying stobs dang*/ yon tan rigs rus bsod nams gang gi cha la'ang phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis phyug pa'i rje btsun gong ma lnga zhes pa'i bla dwags tsam reg pas kyang sa gsum duḥkha rnams skad cig la ming gi go sar 'phen par byed pa/ dpal yon zad pa med pa phan bde'i snang ba dam pas skal bzang gi rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya rnams kyi spyi gtsug mdzes par byed pa'i dam pa gang gi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo re re'i yon tan brjod par yang gzhi lus gcig la mgo stong gis brgyan nas/

slar de la smra bug stong dang*/ der shin tu bde ba'i lce stong sprul nas bskal pa grangs med par brjod par byas kyang cha shas tsam yang mi rdzogs/ 'on kyang skabs 'dir rang re'i skal ba dang 'tsham pa'i ngor spro snang mdzad pa'i thugs rje'i ljags 'dabs las 'phros pa'i gsung rab rnams kyi bsdu bsgrig gi go skal bzang po ji ltar byas pa'i tshul las brtsams te cung zad 'beb gtam gyi gnas la 'jug par bya'o/ /de yang 'dir bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i mdzad rnam dang*/ bdag rkyen rgyal ba mchog las byung ba'i bka' yi mtshan nyid dang dbye ba/ de'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kyi ngo bo dbye ba sgra bshad sogs ni sngon byon mkhas grub snang byed dbang po dag gis zab pa dang rgya che ba'i tshul sna tshogs kyi sgo nas gsal zin pas 'dir ra gan gser 'gran gyi bya ba de dor nas rang dang mtsham pa'i 'bel gtam gyi tshul la 'jug pa skabs su bab pa'o// //de yang tshul gsum gyis gleng bar bya ste/ mdzad pa po'i rnam thar cung zad gleng ba/ skabs don gsung rab bsdu sgrig dngos gleng ba/ slad mar dpe tshan gyi zhal byang smos pa'o/ /dang po ni 'phags pa sdud pa las/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten/ /de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba brten// zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin 'phags pa phal po che'i mdo nas byung ba ltar chos dbyings kun khyab yangs pa'i khyon 'dir gnas bca' ba'i 'jig rten khams gzugs dbyibs dang*/ ngo bo shas che chung*/ bya las/ gnas tshad mi 'dra ba sna tshogs kyi dbus su sa'i go la zhes rang re rnams 'tsho zhing gzhi bca' ba 'di ni/ mtha' rlung dkyil sngo skya rngams su dpag tshad sa ya gcig dang drug 'bum yod pa| rgyar grangs med pa can zhig chags/ de'i nang du me dkyil rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag phyed kyi tshad can zhig chags/ slar de'i nang du chu dkyil sogs las rim par bsgrubs la/

de rnams kyang ngo bo 'byung ba lnga las bsgrubs pa dang*| rnam pa zlum po yin pa/ bya las gtso bo rang 'khor brgyag pa zhig yin te/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ dper na rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo dbyug pas 'phangs nas yongs su 'khor ba de bzhin du gling chen bzhi dang*/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang*/ rgya mtsho chen po 'di yang yongs su 'khor ba mthong ngo zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang mdo las 'jig rten chags pa nas rlung dang bcas pa'i dbyibs ni zlum po'o zhes dang*/ bla ma bu ston gyis nyi zla sa'i go la ni zlum po yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar chags la/ de'i dbus su chus bcad pa'i gling rab mchog sogs che ba drug yod pa dus 'khor las dang*/ yang gnas 'jog gi mdo las ni gling chen bcu drug dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las yul phran stong yod pa dang*/ de'i nang skad rigs bdun brgya yod par gsungs pa'i nang lho gling dbus ma zhes dus 'khor du gsungs pa de ni skabs kyi gleng bya'i gnas 'byung ba snyoms pas khams las 'phos pa'i yon tan du mas spud pa de lags so/ /de yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i thun min yul dbus skal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas mchog drang srong zho 'thung rus las bsgrubs pa'i rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs gangs ljongs sa bla'i zhing ste/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyi skye rabs las/ shar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na// gnas pur rgyal bod ces bya ba yod/ /ces pa de'o/ /de lta'i gnas mchog 'di ni rgya mtsho'i 'phrul sna tshogs kyis bcir bas 'bur du 'thon nas 'dzam gling hril po'i spyi gtsug ltar mngon par 'phags pa zhig ste/ sde pa rin spungs pa chen pos/ nor 'dzin sa 'di'i rgyan du srid pa yis/ /byin pa'i gangs ri dpal gyi do shal can/ /lto ba chos kyi rgyal srid bla na med/ /gling rnams kun gyi gtsug nor 'di yin no/

/zhes pa ltar mtha' bzhi gangs ri chen po dngul dkar gyi mchod rten stong phyogs gcig tu sgeg pas bskor ba lta bu zhig ste/ de yang gangs can rgyal mo'am jo mo glang ma dang*/ gangs rin po che/ jo mo lha ri/ gangs dkar sha med/ jo mo mkha' rigs/ gnyan chen thang lha/ yar lha sham bu/ ko la kha ri/ gnod sbyin gangs bzang*/ bsam gtan gangs bzang*/ rma chen spom ra/ mi nyag gangs dkar/ rong btsan kha ba sogs dang*/ de bzhin gter rigs sna tshogs kyi mdzod chen/ phyi ngos su lcags zhun dang*/ zangs zhun dang*/ dngul zhun/ gser zhun sogs kyis bklubs pa'i brag ri dang*/ rin chen dbang sngon gsar pa'i mdangs kyis byugs pa'i spangs ri dang nags ri sogs kyi ngos las dwangs bsil yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i klung chen seng ge kha bab sogs rtsa chen dal bab rnam bzhi dang*/ rgya mo sngo chu/ rdza chu/ 'bri chu/ dmar chu| lu hi ta sogs shar gling dag byed kyi chu klung che phra kun ljongs 'di las 'phos pa sha stag yin la/ g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal gyi lang tshos spud pa'i mtsho ma phang dang*| gnam mtsho/ yar 'brog g.yu mtsho/ mtsho sngon po/ da du'i tshwa mtsho/ mtsho khri shor rgyal mo/ mtsho sngo ring sogs dang*/ de lhag 'phel zad myur ba'i tshe'u dang*| dri za'i grong khyer ltar rang bzhin gyis snang ba sna tshogs spro ba'i tshe'u dang bcas pas yongs su gtams pa zhig ste/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyi skye rabs las| ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba yod/ /mtsho dma' po g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal yod// gangs dkar po shel gyi mchod rten yod/ /spangs gser po gser gyi lhun po yod| |dri zhim po sman gyi bdug spos yod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /yul ljongs 'di'i nang dbye na bod chen po chol kha gsum las dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ de las kyang gtsang la stod grong pa dpal ldan sa skya ste/ mdo las/ yi ge sa dang skya zhes pa/ /dang po nyid du grags par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i rdo rje'i lung spyi bor lhung ba'i bsgrun bral gnas der mdo sngags rig gnas kun gyi snying po'i bcud kyis mngal dang ldan pa/

gdul bya'i nyon mongs pa'i zug rngu drag po 'byin pa'i 'khur lci bas mnan kyang de rnams la 'jigs pa med pa'i gyad gyangs kyis chos min pham par mdzad pa/ bdud rigs dpa' bkong ba/ chos ldan dar zhing rgyas par mdzad nas rgyal ba bu ram shing pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs mtha'i yul gru kun tu khyab par mdzad pa zhig ste/ rje btsun rin po ches/ sa dkar po seng ge'i gdong pa 'dra/ /dpal sa skya seng ge'i lus/ /'gro drug gi bsam pa 'gengs pa po/ /rje rdo rje 'chang gi bzhugs gnas yin/ /zhes rang bzhin gyi gtam 'byin pa de'o// //bcud kyi sems can la mtshon na lo ngo khri stong mang po'i sngon nas 'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul spre'u yi brgyud las byung nas rim bzhin mi'i 'gro ba 'di byung ba yin la/ de ni deng gi mkhas pa rig gsar pa'i brjod pa rnams kyang ra ba 'di las ma 'das so/ /de nas mi rabs mang por 'tsho sdod mnyam du blang dor nyams myong sna tshogs kyi 'phel rim brgyud/ da yod lo rgyus la snga ba rgyal phran sil ma bzhi bcu'am bcu gnyis sogs byung la/ de nas btsan po'i gdung rabs ni gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung*/ khri bdun/ ldeng gcig legs drug btsan bzhi bcas pa ni sngon gyi rgyal po yin/ de nas lha tho tho ri snyan btsan skabs bstan pa'i dbu brnyes nas rgyal rabs bcu gnyis skabs su dam chos 'phel ba las 'grib pa med/ de'i rjes dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas bod sil bur thor la/ des chab 'bangs rnams la'ang bde sdug sna tshogs nges med kyis gtses kyang*/ bstan pa ni lha btsun chen po'i bka' drin las slar gsos pa 'di'o/ /de bzhin dud 'gror mtshon na bdag bzung dang*/ bdag tu ma bzung ba chu gnas dang*/ ri gnas/ nags gnas sogs brjod kyi mi langs pa ste de lta bu'i dpal gyis legs par brjid par byas pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa de ltar lags so//

//dus ni ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum stong nyis brgya dang*/ bod yul 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srol btod pa po chos rgyal srong btsan 'khrungs nas lo bzhi brgya lnga bcu nga gnyis son pa/ gangs can yul du bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'go thugs rje dang phrin las gang gi cha la'ang bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i lo chen byang chub sems dpa' rin chen bzang po 'khrungs nas lo dgu bcu go dgu 'das pa'i skabs su'o/ /ston pa ni rje btsun gong ma lnga ste 'og tu cung zad spro bar 'dod do// //chos ni 'gro ba'i rtsa lag chen po 'dren mchog gzhan las snying stobs rmad du byung ba kun la phyogs med snyoms pa'i ded dpon chen po/ stong nyid snying rje'i 'phrul las 'khrungs pa/ lus can rnams la'ang de'i tshul gyis gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pas 'tshim par mdzad pa'i kun mkhyen sbyin pa dpal dam pa/ dus gsum gyi dpal stug rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa/ chos nyid kyi klong yangs ngos su phrin las kyi snang ba sna tshogs spro ba/ rig pa dang*| zhabs su ldan pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu dul ba'i kha lor gyur pa| bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya thub pa kun gyis 'dod bya'i zhi ba dang bde ba'i lam ston chen po zhig ste/ mdo las/ zug rngus zugs pa'i sems can gyi/ /skyabs dang dpung gnyen gyur pa yi// zug rngu 'byin pa de bzhin gshegs/ /'jig rten du ni 'byung bar gyur/ /zhes dang*| rgyal tshab byams pa mgon pos/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can// phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa dang*/ /mi phral bde ba'i dgongs pa can/ /phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa ltar theg pa sna tshogs kyis rigs can rnams kyi don mdzad kyang*/ 'dir theg pa thun mong la grags pa ltar cung zad brjod na/ dang po bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis rgya chen po la thugs gzhol ba ste/

'dul ba lung las/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nas// 'dren pa yul 'khor skyong gi bar/ /bdun khri lnga stong tshang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /sangs rgyas legs mdzad nas bzung nas/ /dbang po'i rgyal mtshan thug gi bar/ /bdun khri bdun stong tshang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas ni/ /sangs rgyas 'od srungs bar dag tu/ /bdun khri bdun stong tshang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /zhes pa ltar tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i stobs bcu sogs bral smin yon tan sna tshogs kyi 'od chags pa'i go 'phang sngon du mdzad zin kyang*/ gdul bya'i bsod nams dang skyes mchog gang gi sngon thugs skyes tshad med pa'i smon lam gyi mthu las skal ba mchog dman kun gyi ngor 'bad med lhun grub tu sprul pa sna tshogs kyis phrin las mtha' med pa mkha' ltar khyab pa las/ 'dir 'o cag 'dzam bu gling pa'i spyi mthun bsod nams kyi mgron du byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gcig gi thogs pa lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar skye ba bzhes nas lha'i lo shin tu mang por gang la gang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis skal ldan lha bu rnams kyi 'dod don yid bzhin du 'jo bzhin pa na sngon gyi smon lam dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha'i rol mo'i sgra las/ bsod nams rgya che tshogs mnga' dran rtogs dang*/ /blo gros mtha' yas shes rab 'od mdzad pa// mtshungs med stobs can mthu rtsal stobs mnga' ba/ /mar me mdzad kyi lung bstan dgongs par mdzod/ /ces pa sogs kyis rkyen byas pas dbu'i cod pan rgyal tshab ma pham chen po'i dbur bcings nas tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu'i 'dod pa ltar glang chen thal dkar gzugs kyi mdzad pa dang po nas bcu gnyis bar ston par mdzad do/ /mdzad pa 'di la'ang mdo so sor bgrang tshul 'ga' snang ste grangs bcu gnyis su bstan pa 'di rgya che rol pa dang*/

de bzhin bstan bcos rin chen phreng ba dang*/ rgyud bla ma rnams su bgrang gzhi cung zad mi 'dra yang grangs tshad bcu gnyis mthun par bstan pa dang*/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i mdor mdzad pa bco brgyad dang*/ lang gshegs las mdzad pa bcu drug kyang gsungs so/ /'dir rgya che rol pa ltar bkod na/ lha las bab dang bltams pa dang*| |rol rtsed mdzad dang mngon par byung*/ /dka' ba mdzad dang bdud btul ba/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa yin/ /byang chub dam pa 'khor lo dang*| |nyon mongs can btul dud 'gro ni/ /dregs pa can btul mya ngan 'das| |sangs rgyas pa yi mdzad pa yin/ /zhes bcu gnyis po rnams las skabs 'dir gtso bo chos 'khor bskor ba'i mdzad pa nyid zur du dgar nas cung zad brjod par 'dod de/ de yang rnam 'dren stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag gang gis chos rnams kyi gnas lugs ma 'dres pa gsal ba mngon du gyur nas skal ba mchog gi gdul bya rnams 'dul ba'i phyir bag tsha ba med pa'i nga ro 'di ltar 'byin te/ rgya che rol pa las/ mnyam med mtshungs med nga la su yis bstan| |chos rnams rang gis rtogs nas rab ston pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha mi'i ston pa yin/ /zhes pas ston par khas che bar mdzad kyang*/ slar chos kyi che ba 'don pa'i ched bdun phrag bdun du thugs las chung ngur gnas pa dang mtshungs| zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos zhig kho bos thob/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur bas/ /mi smra nags 'dabs gnas su gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs nas thugs mnyam pa'i ngang bzhugs pa'i tshul mdzad pas/ tshangs pa gtsug phud can dang brgya byin gyis lan du mar chos 'khor bskor ba bskul ba ste/ de yang tshangs pas/ ma ga dhā yi yul 'dir sngon chad chos/ /ma dag dri mas rjes su 'brel ba byung*/ /bdud rtsi'i sgo mo dbye bar mdzod cing chos/ /rdul bral dri ma med pa bstan du gsol/

/zhes pa dang*/ brgya byin gyis/ zla ba nya ba gza' las thar ba ltar/ khyod kyi thugs ni rnam par grol bar lags/ /g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba bzhengs su gsol// 'jig rten mun par shes rab 'od dbyung gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas rkyen byas nas gtso bo sems can gyi bsod nams dang sngon thugs smon stobs can mdzad pa'i dbang gis gdul bya'i mos pa sna tshogs la chos kyi tshul kyang sna tshogs pa zhig ston par mdzad de/ lang dkar gshegs pa las/ byis pa rnams ni yongs drangs phyir/ /theg pa tha dad ngas bshad do/ /zhes pa dang*/ mdo las/ ji ltar nad pa'i nad la ni/ /sman pas sman rnams sbyin pa ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal ba sems can la/ /ci tsam bzod pa'i chos bstan to/ /zhes chos 'khor rim pa gsum bskor bar mdzad pa ste/ dang po ni yul wā rā ṇa sīr 'khor lnga sde la/ nga ni thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /nga ni thams cad ston pa'o/ /tshur shog la legs par nyon cig dang*/ ngas khyed rnams la dam pa'i chos bstan par bya'o/ /zhes pas rab tu 'phyung nas/ gnas 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram du bka' bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor gyis gtsos mi lo bdun bar du bskor bar mdzad do||

||gnyis pa ni ltaing rgyal 'od srungs dang de'i spun chu klung 'od srungs dang ga ya 'od srungs 'khor brgya lnga bcu dang bcas pa ston par khas blangs sogs kyis bsnyen pa rdzogs par mdzad pa dang*/ de dang lhan du nyer rgyal dang pang na skyes gnyis yang 'phags pa rta thul gyi spyod pa sogs la dad nas 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu dang bcas pa'ang rab tu byung nas rim bzhin maung gal gyi bu dang*/ sha ri'i bu zhes mtshan gsol nas 'khor tshogs de rnams dang*/ lhag par theg pa chen po'i 'khor bzhis gtsor byas pa rnams la gnas rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo mi lo bcu'i bar du bskor bar mdzad do// //gsum pa ni shākya bzang ldan sogs 'khor lnga brgya la ston pas tshur shog sogs kyis bsnyen pa rdzogs par mdzad nas/ gnas ni ser skya dang*/ gnyan yod/ yangs pa can/ pad+mo can/ lang ka pu ri sogs su bka' tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo mi lo sum cu'i bar bskor ro// zhes theg pa spyi tsam las theg chen ltar na chos kyi phung po brgyas khri bzhi stong gsungs zhes pa'ang kun dga' bos thos pa rnams tshad du byas pa tsam la dgongs nas bshad pa las don du na mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ su zhig sangs rgyas chos la tshad 'dzin pa/ /mi de'i sems ni shin tu myos par gyur// tshad las 'das pa la ni tshad gzung med/ /'dren pa yon tan thams cad bsam mi khyab/ /zhes gsungs pas theg chen thun min la grangs dang 'khor gnas chos la mtha' gcig tu nges bzung byed par dka' ste/ gsung gcig nyid du gsung na yang*/ /du ma nyid du so sor go /zhes pas so// //gsang sngags byung tshul ni gdul bya las dag dbang rnon gyi ngor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas sna tshogs su so skye'i spyod yul las 'das pa'i rgyud kyi rnam grangs dpag tu med pa gsungs nas/

re zhig de ltar ston pa mchog gi 'khor lo gsum po rnams bka' gsum gyis gdams pas gtan la phabs pa sogs mdzad de/ 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya zad pa dang/ skye ba'i mtha'i chos nyid bstan pa dang*/ 'khor ba la yid 'byung bar bskul ba dang*/ sangs rgyas rnyed dka' ba sogs kyi dgos pa bstan phyir rtswa can du mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul mdzad do// //de lta bu'i ston pa mchog gi so so yang dag rig pa bzhi dang mi 'jigs pa rnam par bzhi'i ngang las byung ba spobs pa bzhi ldan gyi chos/ gsung rnams kyi nang nas rab tu gyur pa skal ldan rnams kyis nyan pa dang bsam pa bsgoms pas nyams su bstar na mngon mtho nges legs kyi 'bras bu bde blag tu 'byor nus la de nyid la'ang spyi sgos kyi khyad par phra mo rnams shes na gdul bya'i blo 'chos thub pa kho na yin kyang*/ mtha' drug gi ngo bo rnams legs par ma shes na 'khrul par gol ba 'gyur bas de bzlog pa'i phyir/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ /bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtag la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yis gus phyir min/ /zhes dang*/ mdo rgyan las/ don sgra ji bzhin yongs rtog na| |bdag nyid snyems shing blo nyams 'gyur/ /legs par gsungs pa'ang spangs pas na/ /brlag 'gyur chos la khong khros sgrib/ /ces dang*/ yang de nyid las| de mtha' de tsam kho nar nges byas nas/ /de mtha' de tsam kho nar nges byas na/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i gsung dang 'gal 'gyur bas/ /de na mtha' min dgongs pa dpyad par bya/ /zhes dang*/ dpal ldan zla bas kyang*/ mtha' drug bral bas nges par rtogs zhes gang smra ba/ /zla ba lta 'dod sor mo'i rtse la blta dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis kyang*/ bstan bcos dang 'gal ba ni sla'i/ bka' dang 'gal ba ni de ltar ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas na rtog ge'i blo can rnams kyi de lta bu'i tshul gyis dpyad de nyams su len pa las/

brda tshad gyis blo cung zad khengs pa de rgyu mtshan du byas nas 'gal ma nges ma grub pa'i skyon ltar snang sna tshogs kyis sangs rgyas gsung la tshod bgam sna tshogs 'degs pa ni nam mkha' sbar mos 'gebs pa'i brtul zhugs yin pas na/ snang tshul chos su snang yang ngo bo rang nyid ngan song du 'gro ba'i las bsags na de bshags thabs bral ba zhig stai/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig yang yang sdig grogs bsten pas sangs rgyas ngan sems ldan gyur dang*// pha ma dgra bcom gsod par bya ba min byed mchog tshogs 'byed pa'i mi/ /de yang chos nyid nges par bsam na myur du de las thar 'gyur gyi/ /gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod/ /ces gsungs pa dang*/ rang re'i mes po'i ngag rgyun las kyang*/ sdig can chos kyis thul kyang*/ chos dregs chos kyis mi thul/ zhes pa'ang tshul 'di rigs la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin pas thun mong gi sgra tshad la zhen brtas nas rtog brtags cal col sna tshogs kyis bstan pa dang rang nyid brlag pa'i las ngan la mi brtson par zhu'o// //de lta bu'i bdag rkyen sangs rgyas las byung ba'i spobs pa bzhi ldan gyi bka' yi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i skyes bu rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos las blo rtul rnams kyis kyang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bka' yi dgongs pa ji bzhin rtogs par nus te/ rje sa chen gyis/ lung bstan gyur pa klu sgrub la sogs dang*/ /mkha' 'gros byin rlobs bir+wa pa la sogs/ /grub thob rnams kyi gsung shul la brten nas/ /rjes 'jug skye bos bka' yi don rnams rtogs// zhes gang zag gang zhig dgongs gzhi rgyal ba'i bstan la dgongs pa rnam g.yeng med pa'i yid can gyis brtsams pa/ 'chos skyabs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig ni bstan bcos yin la/ des ni rgyal ba'i bka' rgya che la grangs bdo ba/ go rim dkrug pa rnams kyi don yang bde ba'i thabs kyis rtogs nus la/

de la'ang bka' spyi'i dgongs pa 'grel ba sgra dang tshad ma gnyis dang*/ bka' bye brag gi dgongs pa 'grel ba ni gzhung so so'i skabs ste/ de yang bka' 'khor lo dang po'i dgongs 'grel la ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu gnyis song ba'i skabs| grong khyer bcom brlags tu dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa sogs kyis mdzad pa'i bye brag bshad mdzod chen po dang*/ de bzhin mngon pa mdzod rtsa 'grel| 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ tshig le'ur byas pa/ sum brgya pa/ 'od ldan sogs yin la/ bka' bar pa'i dgongs pa 'grel ba la rigs tshogs lnga dang*/ rtsa sher 'grel chen bzhi/ de bzhin bzhi brgya pa/ mngon rgyan/ 'jug pa/ brgyad stong don bsdus/ 'bum ṭikā don gsal sogs dang*/ bka' tha ma'i dgongs 'grel ni byams chos bar pa gsum dang*/ de dag so so'i 'grel pa/ kun las btus dang*/ nyi shu pa/ sum cu pa/ phung po lnga'i rab byed/ rnam bshad rig pa/ dmigs brtags sogs sems tsam par btags pa'i dgongs 'grel rnams yin la/ de bzhin bka' bar pa dang tha ma gnyis ka'i dgongs 'grel ni sa sde lnga dang*/ bslab btus gnyis dang*/ mdo btus gnyis/ spyod 'jug rin phreng*/ sems 'grel/ sdom pa nyi shu/ slob spring*/ lam sgron sogs 'dod/ de rnams kyang byed las sgo nas rtsa sher mngon rgyan lta bu zab mo 'byed pa'i bstan bcos dang*| rin phreng*/ spyod 'jug kun btus lta bu rgya che ba bsdus pa'i bstan bcos| mdor byas sam mtsho skyes dang*/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ sdom pa nyi shu pa/ rtsa ltung gi sdom lta bu 'khrugs pa go rim sdebs pa'i bstan bcos yin par gsungs so/ /de lta'i mdo sngags rig gnas kyi bstan bcos su grags pa rnams la tshig don gang gi cha la'ang khungs dang ldan pa zhig yin min legs par ma brtags na rgya gzhung du grags pa la'ang brdzun pa yod la/ de bzhin rang gis brtsams pa mkhas pa gong mar kha btags pa sogs kyang yod pas blo gros ldan pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa dang*/

rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rang stobs kyis 'grel nus pa'i srol 'byed chen po dag gis brtsams pa dang*| de dang de'i slob brgyud kyi skyes bu rnams kyis mdzad pa/ bsdus pa po byang chub sems dpa' dang dgra bcom pa/ de mtshungs brgyud pa bzang por ldan pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta las byung ba/ don ji bzhin grub thob kyis bsgoms pas nyams rtogs 'khrul med 'khrungs pa dang*/ tshad ldan skyes bus lung rigs rnam dag gis gtan la phabs pa las dar ba/ bod du'ang lo tsā ba mkhas pa dag gis bsgyur ba/ lung rigs man ngag gis phyug pa'i mkhas grub rnams la grags shing grub pa zhig la nyan bshad bsgom pas nyams su len par mdzad na dus dang blo gros gron du mi 'gyur bas de lta'i thabs la bsten dgos la/ bod yul 'di nyid la'ang 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams dang dbyer med pa'i dpon slob brgyud pa rnams la grags shing de las 'phel ba rnams la phyogs dang ris su ma chad par dad pa dag snang gcig gis dang du blangs dgos la| bka' bstan gyi dgongs pa min par rang gar skye bo brdzun mas sbyar ba la rmongs pa bla ma kho na brtsis su byed pa rnams la nges pa ma mchis pas btang snyoms su bzhag na bde bar mngon no// //'khor la brgyud pa snga ma rnams kyi rgyun ji ltar 'bab pa'i tshul dang*/ brgyud pa 'di nyid kyi skyes chen ngos bzung ba/ de las brgyud pa phyi ma rnams ji ltar 'phel ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ ston pa mchog gi 'das lo la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang yang 'dir sa pho byi ba la mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi lo shing n+ya gro dha'i phug dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas su 'od srungs chen po la sogs pa dgra bcom pa lnga brgya 'tshogs te/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras sbyin bdag byas nas/ chos gos bzhi brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu bting pa'i khrir kun dga' bo dang*/ nye bar 'khor/ 'od srungs chen po rnams rim pas bzhugs/

'khor yang 'od srungs la sogs pa rnams kyis thal mo sbyar te 'di skad brjod do/ /ston pa 'jig rten phan bzhed pa/ /rgyal bas gsung pa'i chos rnams kyi/ /rnam pa mchog ni gang bshad pa/ /tshe dang ldan pa mdo sde gsungs/ /zhes pas gsol ba btab nas rim pa ltar kun dga' bos mdo sde/ nye bar 'khor gyis 'dul ba/ 'od srungs chen pos mngon pa bsdus pa dang mtshungs 'di skad gsungs/ rngam brjid can gyis seng ge'i khri'i steng nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis/ kye ma stobs bcu mnga' ba'i gsung ni tshad med pa'i/ /'gro la phan phyir chos kyi bstan bcos 'di bsdus pas/ /gang na 'jig rten blo ngan mun byed chud zos pa/ /blo gros rab rib bsal nas sgron me yang dag bstan/ /gang gis thub pa'i sde snod la| |yang dag bsdus nas chos la bzhag /gcig nas gcig tu yun ring bar||ston pa'i bstan pa gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs nas kun dga' bo la bstan pa gtad pa dang mtshungs 'khrul bral rdo rje'i ngag gis dge slong sha na'i gos can kyang lung bstan to/ /'phags chen kun dga' bos kyang dge slong sha na'i gos can thub pa'i bstan pa lo lnga'i dus ston byed pa can der bstan pa gtad pa dang nyer sbas kyang lung bstan/ nyer sbas chen po ni ston pa mchog gis nga mya ngan 'das nas lo brgya na mtshan dang mi ldan zhes bya bas sangs rgyas kyi bya ba thams cad byed do/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i dgra bcom pa chen po nyi ma gung pa ste| kha che'i yul du klu gdug pa can btul nas yul der gnas bca' bar mdzad de ri spos ngad ldan nas gur gum blangs te btab pa'i gnas 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang lhan du gnas pa der bstan pa gtad/ des nag po la/ des legs mthong la bstan pa gtad do/ /de ni theg dman lugs gtso bor brjod pa yin la/ theg chen ni rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis mdo sde dang*/ byams pas 'dul ba/ phyag na rdo rjes mngon pa bsdus zhes dang*/

yang bsil ba tshal gyi mdo las 'byung ba ltar na kun dga' bo phyag rdor sprul par yang bshad do| |gsang sngags ni gnas nges med du so skye'i blo las 'das pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis bsdu bar mdzad la rigs khongs ni gsung rab kyi dbang du byas na shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod du 'dus te/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa las gsungs so/ /sde snod kyi dbang du na paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa dang*/ bod kyi mkhas pa stag tshang sogs 'ga' zhig gis sde snod gsum ga'i nang 'dus par bzhed la/ bla ma khams pa sogs 'gas mi rtog pa'i bya ba gtsor bstan pas na mngon pa'i sde snod yin par bzhed pa dang*/ yang rje sa chen sogs 'ga' zhig gis gsang sngags mdo sde'i tshul du bshad/ /ces pa'i lung gis mdo sde'i khongs su'ang bzhed do/ / de ltar bstan pa dag par byas kyang slar yangs pa can gyi dge slong gis hu lu hu lu sogs mi rung ba'i gzhi bcus bstan pa dri ma can du byas pa de'i nyes pa sel phyir ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu na kun dga' bo'i mkhan bu kho na dge slong bdun brgyas gnas yangs pa can du rgyal po dharma a sho kas sbyin bdag mdzad nas bka' bsdu ba gnyis pa byas so// //slar bsod nams nya phra 'du 'dzi bdos drags pas dge slong ma hā de bas bstan pa rma can du byas pa'i rkyen gyis sde pa bzhi las gyes pa bco brgyad ( 'di'i skabs su sde pa bco brgyad gyes la/ de yang rtog ge 'bar bar lugs gnyis bshad de/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu drug pa chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi dus su/ grong khyer me tog gis brgyan par dge 'dun rnams 'khrug long byung bas phal cher ba dang*/ gnas brtan pa gnyis gyes nas de las sde pa bco brgyad byung ba sogs dang*/ yang ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang so bdun na grong khyer pa ṭa li pu trar rgyal po dga' bo dang bang chen gyi dus su bdud sdig can bzang po zhes bya bas dge slong gi cha byad du sprul nas rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pas dge 'dun bye ste gong ltar gyes pa sogs gsungs yod do||

) rnams phan tshun rtsod pa che bar gyur pas/ ston pa 'das nas lo sum brgya na kha che'i yul gyi bye brag kun pa na zhes bya ba'i dgon pa dzā lan+dha rar rgyal po ka ni kas sbyin bdag mdzad de/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyes bu lnga brgya dang*/ dgra bcom pa seng ge sogs nyan thos dgra bcom lnga brgya/ so skye'i paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya 'dus nas sde pa kun rgyal po kri kri rmi lam ( bco brgyad pa de yin/ ) bzhin yang dag tu bsgrubs/ de mtshungs sde snod rnams nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i lung bzhin yi ger yang phabs so// //theg chen brgyud pa ni lang gshegs 'grel pa las/ dhi ti ka yan thun mong ba yin/ de rjes bi dhā ga dang*/ bud+dhā nan+ti/ bud+dha mi tra/ dge slong rtsibs/ su noḥsha ta/ rta skad/ ma shi ba/ klu sgrub sogs las brgyud par gsungs la/ de yang theg chen mngon pa lta bu 'ga' zhig ni sprang po nyi ma'i dngos grub kyis gtsug lag khang rnams mer bsreg pas rtsa stong la phyin pa phyis 'phags pa thogs med kyis mi pham mgon la gsan nas cung zad dar ro/ /de lta bu'i brgyud tshul mi 'dra ba rnams kyang rgyal ba mchog gi gdul bya'i khams mos bzhin sprul pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro don mdzad pa las 'phros pa gor ma chag go

/ da ni slob brgyud rnams kyis bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs tshul la rgya gar du dar tshul dang*/ bod du dar tshul gnyis las dang po ni/ gong gi bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun las gtso bo theg dman dar ba ma zad/ gling phran gzhan la'ang shin tu rgya cher dar ba rnams kyang spyir ni slob dpon chen po bzhi las brgyud pa zhig ste/ btsun pa chos skyong dang*/ dbyis bshes dang*/ dbyangs sgrogs| sangs rgyas lha rnams las so/ /theg chen ni gong gi klu sgrub dang*/ thogs med/ phyogs glang rnams la gzhung mdzad pa'i rgyan gsum dang*/ 'phags pa lha/ dbyig gnyen/ chos grags rnams la 'grel pa mdzad pa'i rgyan gsum ste rgyan drug yin la/ de bzhin bod du ni yon shāka gnyis la mchog gnyis su grags pa dang*/ de mtshungs rmad byung slob dpon gnyis sam gsum dang*/ shes rab 'byung gnas sogs mkhas pa sgo drug slob dpon rta dbyangs sogs rgya gar dbus kyi paṇ+ḍi ta bdun dang*/ dge 'dun bzang po sogs kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta brgyad| bsod nams sde sogs khu sems kyi paṇ+ḍi ta brgyad dang*/ dharma rak+ṣi ta sogs yu gur gyi slob dpon nyi shu sogs las byung la/ lhag par rgya gar la bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen gnyis te/ brtul zhugs kyis bstan pa 'dzin pa bir+wa pa dang*/ rtsod pas bstan pa 'dzin pa chos grags zhes rlung ltar grags pa ste mdor na bod kyi bka' 'gyur gyi 'gyur byang dang*/ bstan gyur sogs su mtshan 'khod pa'ang bzhi brgya tsam dngos su yod pa rnams kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /de bzhin theg chen gsang sngags la'ang chos rgyal zla bzang sogs sham bha la'i rigs ldan brgyud pa rnams dang*/ tsi lu pa gong 'og ur+yan gyi rgyal po 'byung po'i dbang po gsum sogs kyi brgyud pa rnams dang*/ lhag par grub chen sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sa ra ha chung ba/ ti lo pa dang*/ nā ro/ lū nag dril gsum/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa gnyis/

slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ ḍom+bi pa/ gha ya dha ra/ ye shes zhabs/ dran pa'i ye shes grags pa/ pham thing ba sku mched gsum/ a mo gha badz+ra/ pad+ma badz+ra/ bha ro phyag ldum/ haṃ ngu dkar po/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ mai tri ba/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung dag dang*/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po sogs las gtso bo bla med rgyud dang*/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba dang*| kun dga' snying po/ ye shes 'od 'phro/ chags med rgyal po/ zhi ba snying po sogs las rnal 'byor rgyud/ slob dpon byang chub mchog sogs las bya spyod rnams 'phel ba ste mdor na grub chen brgyad cu sogs bsam brjod las 'das pa'i paṇa grub rnams kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa tshul sna tshogs kyis gzhi gcig tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa las phyogs mtha'i yul gru rnams su 'phel ba 'di rnams so/ /de rnams ni 'phags yul du skyes bu dam pas bstan pa 'dzin pa'i tshul mdor tsam mo// //gnyis pa gangs can du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ pur rgyal yul 'dir btsan po'i gdung rabs rje gnya' khri nas gdung rabs nyer gcig tu dam pa'i chos ma byung*/ de nas gdung rabs nyer gnyis pa/ lha tho tho ri'i skabs dam chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas gdung rabs lnga na mnga' bdag srong btsan byung la de'i skabs dam pa'i chos kyi srol gtod de chos dge ba bcu las brtsams pa'i khrims bcas/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang mtshungs dam chos 'ga' zhig yang bsgyur te slob grwa'i grwa btsug pa tsam las/ btsun pa las sdom pa blangs pa'i srol dang*/ sngags pa las dbang bskur ba'i tshul ma dar/ de nas gdung rabs lnga na mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan skabs shin tu dar zhing rgyas pas/ rnam dag khrims khang gling du rab tu byung ba dang*/ bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du dbang bskur ba'i rgyun btsugs nas bstan pa'i snying po gsal bar mdzad/ de'i sras khri lde srong btsan dang de sras ral pa can gyi skabs sngar ma bsgyur ba'i bstan bcos mang po bsgyur ba dang*/

bsgyur zin rnams kyang skad gsar bcad kyis bcos te de rnams kyi gzhi bca' ba'i rten sgra bcom bam gnyis kyang gtan la phabs so/ /de'i rjes gdung rabs lngar chos nyams nas bshad sgrub kyi srol gsha' ma ma dar/ de nas mnga' bdag bkra shis mgon la sras khor srong dag bltams pa'i gcen ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gangs ri can gyi rgyal khams na/ /rigs ni rgyal rigs zhes bya la/ /ye shes 'od ces bya ba 'byung*| |zhes 'khrul bral lung gis phogs pa des/ yab mes kyi srol 'dzin phyir rten gyi drung du rab tu byung nas ( 'di'i skabs lo chen dgung lo bcu gsum dus mkhan po ye shes bzang po las rab tu byung ba'i skabs lha bla ma lhan du yod pa'ang bzhed do// ) mtshan ye shes 'od du btags so// ( 'di'i mtshan la bla ma byang chub sems dpa'ang bya'o// ) chos rgyal chen po des rje'u rigs kyi blo rig bkra ba'i byis pa lo bcu las mi rgan pa bdun rin gyis nyos/ de rnams la gser mang po bskur ba dang mtshungs de bzhin paṇ+ḍi ta dang*| bstan bcos 'ga' zhig gi mtshan bcas kyang mngags bskur mdzad de/ re re la g.yog dang*/ nye g.yog dang bcas kha cher brdzangs so/ /de rnams las lhu zor rin chen bzang po ( lo chen ) dang jo bo legs pa'i shes rab ( lo chung ) thon skad| 'di dag ni spyir bod gangs can pa rnams dang*/ yang dgos nang pa sangs rgyas pa kun la shin tu drin che ba zhig ste/ pho brang zhi ba 'od kyi zhal snga nas| sngon gyi smon lam thugs rje'i dbang gi na/ /lha rigs byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa ni/ /sa steng rgyal po chen po'i skur 'khrungs pas/ /'gro ba skyabs phyir khyim gnas spangs pa ste/ /bla ma byang chub sems dpa' ye shes 'od// mnga' ris stod 'di 'dul ba'i don du byon/ /zhes dang*/ dgos pa ni/ gsang sngags spyod pa'i lugs kun nyams pa dang*/ /dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg cho ga nub gyur pas/

/dkyil 'khor cho ga pad+ma stong ldan te/ /de bzhin sbyin sreg shag te shu tis byed/ /gzhan yang gsang sngags sbas don nub gyur cing*/ /sbyor sgrol dang ni tshogs la sogs pas bslad/ /'di rnams don gnyer btsal phyir bka' gnyer te/ /lo tsā rin chen bzang po kha cher brdzangs/ /zhes gsungs te dgos pa ni/ mdo rgyud dang mi mthun pa'i 'dres chos rnams dag par bya ba'i phyir yin no| |de'ang lo chen 'di ni mkhas rgu'i yon tan gyis phyug pa bstan pa spyi dang bye brag nang rig la bka' drin shin tu che ba zhig yin la gang zag rang ngos nas yon tan re re'i cha la bsams kyang bya ba de rang la sku tshe gang po thugs 'bum pa lta bu yod/ phyis gangs ljongs 'dir bstan pa'i gzhi rtsa brtan pa 'di yang lo tsā bka' drin can 'di rang gi drin yin te/ pho brang zhi ba 'od kyi zhal snga nas/ shrad+dha ka ra zhes bya spyan drangs te/ /sgron gsal spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma sogs| |bsgyur zhing bshad nas sngags log gzhung bsal phyir/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa chen po'i lugs la btsud/ /de bzhin sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor cho ga dang*| |sgom sgrub la sogs bye brag sna tshogs pa'i/ /skyon med gzhung lugs rnams la 'gro kun sbyar/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang sogs rim gyis bstsal// deng sang bar du sngags kyi gzhung dar ba/ /lo tsā skyes mchog 'di yi drin yin grang*| |zhes gsungs pa ltar bstan pa spyi yongs la bka' drin bla na med pa bskyangs so/ /de'i slob brgyud la bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig yod kyang gtso bor gyur pa ni/ bzhi las dang po lo chung legs sher ni gzhung gdams ngag spyi dang khyad par ye shes zhabs lugs la shin tu mkhas skad/ gnyis pa brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan ni yo ga spyi dang khyad par shar phyogs kho na'i gzhung 'dzin par thugs brtas che la thugs rab kyang shin tu rno skad/ gsum pa skyi nor dzñā na ni yo ga shar phyogs kho na'i gzhung 'dzin kyang thugs rab de tsam med par grags|

bzhi pa kra ka pa gi zhon she ni yo ga shar nub gnyis kar mkhas pa ma zad lugs gnyis ka gces pas bskyang bar mdzad mkhan zhig yin pas bod kyi yo ga'i shing rta chen por 'dzin no/ /de bzhin rkyang po chos blo dang*/ spang khar 'dar chung*/ mdog pa kle ston/ bal shākya rdo rje/ thang ston kong ka pa sogs ni lo chen gyi sku tshe stod kyi slob mar grags/ smad la zhang shes rab bla ma dang/ sum pa ye 'bar/ shangs kyi srog ye gzhon/ nyang smad lce zhar rnams ni lo che chung gnyis ka'i slob ma yin par gsungs/ lce zhar 'di las slob ma spru 'bar tog dang*/ sum pa rgyal blo sogs shin tu mang skad/ lo chung la slob ma zangs dkar 'phags pa dang*/ de'i slob ma an grags pa rin chen/ pu rangs pa zla 'od sogs thon no/ /de bzhin dge bshes gnyal pa sogs las mdo sngags kyi bstan pa shin tu rnam par dag pa sngar med bsgyur ba/ nyams pa rnams gsos nas gong du spel ba dang*/ log pa sun 'byin pa'i ngang nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad la/ de rnams kyi slob brgyud du 'brog mi lo tsā ba dang*/ grags 'byor shes rab/ pho brang zhi ba 'od/ rgya brtson seng*/ nag tsho| 'brom/ rngog legs sher/ dad pa shes rab/ ga rod/ she'u rdo rje lha/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ rje mar pa dang*/ se khar chung ba/ mar do/ mal gyo blo gros grags pa/ gyi ljang*/ rwa lo/ khyung po/ gnyan lo/ rta nag pa 'gos lhas btsas/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ de bzhin dbu ma'i bstan pa spel ba pa tshab dang khu mdo sde dpal sogs byung la/ lhag par sde snod kyi bshad pa'i 'brug sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che rgyu mtshan dpyad pa du ma'i sgo nas yang dag par spel ba'i ded dpon dam pa rngog lo bstan pa'i nyi ma blo ldan shes rab 'dis khu bo dang*/ bram ze sadz+dza na sogs la gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad nas bshad pa'i 'ur gyis gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir bstan pa'i dge mtshan lhag par mngon par mdzad pa de rnams kyi gdams pa'i chu bo rnams 'du ba'i yul ni dpal ldan sa skya pa ste/

bka' bab bdun ldan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang pos/ 'dzam gling thub pa'i rgyal tshab sa skya pa'i| |chos kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma ru/ /ma gyur gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bstan 'dzin du/ /zhal gyis mches pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' yod min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon byon lo paṇa dam pa rnams kyi lung rigs man ngag kun 'du ba dang*/ sngar med rnams slar srol 'byed par mdzad pa'i rgya mtsho chen po dang chos mtshungs pas phyi 'byung lugs mi 'dra ba kun gzhi 'di las dngos shugs kyi ma brgyud pa zhig med/ 'di ni gnas ming grub mtha' la chags pa zhig yin pa dang*/ lugs 'di'i srog 'byed pa po ni rje btsun gong ma lnga yin la skabs kyi gleng bya'i gnas kyang yin pas skyes chen rnams kyi rnam thar gnad bsdus tsam brjod par spro'o/ /de yang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bram ze'i rigs su gsal bar ma byung bas brgyud pa 'di'i rigs ni rje'u rigs yin te dkon pa rje gung stag tu grags pa de nas 'dzin par mkhas pa 'gas bshad/ rus ni rus chen bzhi dang mi'u gdung drug sogs las mched pa ma yin par/ sngon dus 'od gsal lha'i nang du 'jam dbyangs sprul pa mched gsum las 'bring po g.yu ring gi mu bza' ldem mu khab tu bzhes pa'i sras ma sang spun bdun las tha chung ma sang spyi rje nas mched pa'i gdung la 'od gsal lha'i gdung brgyud du grags/ spyi rje nas gdung rabs bzhi pa klu tsha stag po dang mon bza' mtsho mo rgyal la rigs sras g.ya' spangs skyes 'khrungs/ des srin po skya rengs khrag med bsad nas chung ma g.ya' 'brum si li ma khab tu bzhes pa nas gdung rabs bcu tsam la lha rigs 'khon gyi gdung du grags/ de'i phyi ma shākya blo gros la sras gnyis te gcen 'khon rabs shes rab tshul khrims ni gzhon nu nas lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi mkhan bu zhu ston brtson 'grus las go ma'i dge bsnyen mdzad nas tshangs spyod la shin tu btsun pas sras med la lhag par yab mes kyi chos la grub pa thob pas rtags dang nus mthu shin tu che ba zhig go

/des na 'khon klu'i dbang po nas 'khon rab shes rab tshul khrims bar kyi mkhas grub rnams kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung lugs dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba sde drug le lag dang bdun/ phra mo nyi shu rtsa gcig gtso bor bzung nas spyod pa/ de dag gi gdams pa dgos kyi chos drug ces bya ba'i man ngag dang ldan zhing*/ yang dag grub pa dang*/ phur pa'i yi dam gyi sgo nas dngos grub kyi rim pa thob pa kho na yin no gsungs so/ /gcung 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po ni/ ( spyi lo 1034 ) yab mes kyi chos la man ngag dang sgrub thabs phra mo tsam gyis 'tshim par mdzad nas gcen gyis bka' mngags mdzad pa ltar rje 'brog ma'i mdun nas gzhung khrid mang po gsan ( man ngag brgyud pa min ) de bzhin 'brog ma'i slob ma khyem lo tsā ba/ 'gos khug pa/ o rgyan gyi paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab gsang ba/ mal lo tsā ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sgyi chu ba/ pu hrang lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa sku mched/ skyu ra a skyabs sogs las gsan bsam mtha' yas pa mdzad nas rang lo bzhi bcu pa chu mo glang lo ( spyi lo 1073 ) la bra bo lung par sa skya gog po zhes pa'i dgon chung zhig phyag btab ste/ bdag cag gi ston pas/ yi ge sa dang skya zhes pa/ /dang po nyid du grags par 'gyur/ /ces pa'i rdo rje'i lung de mngon du gyur to/ /de nas lha rigs 'khon sa skya zhes pa'i mtshan mchog gsum sbrag ma de chags so/ /mthar dgung lo re dgu bzhes pa rab byung gnyis pa'i chu khyi ( spyi lo 1140 ) dbyu gu zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la sgo rum du zhi bar gshegs so// //da ni gnyis pa de las brgyud pa'i rje btsun gong ma lnga yi rnam thar dngos cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ ma 'ongs 'khon gdung gang zag yin nges rnams/ /nga yi nyan thos rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang*/

/grub chen brgyad cu'i rnam 'phrul ma gtogs pa/ /skye ba dman pa gzhan dag 'byung re skan| |zhes dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan gyis/ ngang pa'i rgyal po pad mtsho dang*/ /nyin mor byed pa mkha' la bzhin/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyang*| |mtho dang gtsang ma'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /zhes bsngags pa mdzad pa'i brgyud yab 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dgung lo nga dgur phebs dus yum ma gcig zhang mo'i sras su rab byung gnyis pa'i chu pho spre'u ( spyi lo 1092 ) lor sa skyar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag gnam kha'u pas sku pang du bzhes shing nges par spyan ras gzigs sam byang sems sbyin pa dpal nyid dam rnal 'byor dbang phyug gang rung zhig gi sprul par mi 'gal lo gsungs| thog mar yab las yi ge'i 'bri klog dang brtag pa rnam brgyad/ rtsis rigs sogs la sbyangs pa mdzad pa dang kye rdo rje'i dbang gis smin par mdzad nas yab la mnga' ba'i chos ci rigs pa gsan no/ /dgung lo bcu gcig skabs yab gshegs/ de'i rjes yum dang bla ma gnyis kas lo tsā ba las slob gnyer bya dgos par gdams pa dang mtshungs rig pa sgrub pa'i lha 'phags pa 'jam dpal zla ba drug bsgrubs pas 'grub ste 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs shing chos thams cad la snang ba gsal bar shar ba dang mtshungs chos thams cad kyi gnas 'dus pa'i gdams pa zhen pa bzhi bral 'di yang bstsal to// dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i dus rong ngur smig tu brang ti dar ma snying po la mngon pa tshar gcig gsan pas kun thugs su chud pas kun gyis ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa byung gsungs/ de dang mtshungs brang ti'i zur chos bya chad pa khyung la sa sde lnga dang sdom rnam gnyis sogs kyang khong du chud par mdzad/ nyang stod du khyung rin chen grags la tshad ma rnam nges dang rigs thigs sogs gsan pas rigs pa'i rgyal por gyur/

de nas bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba las dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas phal po che gzhung rab tu dbye ba dang*/ de bzhin pha rol tu phyin pa'i gnas mang po khong du chud par mdzad la/ gsang sngags la bya ba'i rgyud las rgyud sde dum bu nyis brgya dang de'i yan lag man ngag phra mos brgyan pa dang bcas pa gsan/ spyod rgyud la gshin rje gshed/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ de bzhin rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud la gsang 'dus lugs bzhi 'grel pa yan lag dang bcas pa/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i rgyud gsum dpal 'dzin gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum yan lag dang bcas pa/ bde mchog rtsa bshad rgyud rnams kyi man ngag phra mo dang bcas pa/ de bzhin rdo rje gdan bzhi'i 'grel pa yan lag dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor 'grel pa yan lag dang bcas pa/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i byin rlobs rnams dang de'i man ngag phra mo kun khong du chud par mdzad do/ /grong pa g.yu rtse 'bying phur dge bshes me lhang tsher la rnam nges/ rigs thigs rgya 'grel bam po bco lnga pa/ dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum dang*/ de nas g.yas ru'i ltag ris kyi sa'i cha sgyi chu'i gtsug lag khang du sgyi chu ba chen por dges rdor rgyud gsum/ rgyud chung gsum sogs dang*/ yang bla ma de nyid las dges rdor 'gos brgyud lugs bla ma mnga' ris par gsan pa rnal 'byor rin po che phreng ba'i 'grel pa yan lag du ma dang bcas pa rnams kyang gsan no||de bzhin bya rgyud rig pa mchog gi rgyud sogs dang*/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang rgyud 'grel phran dang bcas pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud la de nyid 'dus pa sogs gsan par mdzad/ bla med la gong gi dgyes rdor dang de bzhin ma hā mā ya| sangs rgyas thod pa/ zla gsang thig le'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i 'grel pa yan lag dang bcas pa gsan/

yang bla ma de nyid las rje mar pa lo tsā ba'i slob ma mes ston tshon po las nos pa'i kye rdo rje dang*/ gur/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ ma hā mā ya rgyud rkyang pa dang*/ rgyud bzhi'i bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa rnams kyang gsan cing khong du chud par mdzad/ bla ma mnga' ris pa'i lugs dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum dang*/ bslab btus spyod 'jug rnams kyang gsan de bzhin mnga' ris gung thang du rje btsun mal gyo lo tsā ba chen po'i zhabs drung du bsnyen te dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*| a bhi da na/ he ru ka mngon 'byung*/ kun tu spyod pa/ saṃ pu ṭa/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor gyi rgyud/ phag mo mngon par 'byung ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ kun spyod 'grel pa lū hi pa'i yan lag phra mo dang bcas pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa yan lag dang bcas pa/ nag po'i chos drug nā ro mkha' spyod rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag phra mo dang bcas pa rnams khong du chud par mdzad la/ gzhan yang bla ma de nyid las bha ro phyag rdum las brgyud pa'i gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud gsum 'grel pa dang rgyud rkyang gi lugs gnyis man ngag phra mo dang bcas pa gsan/ de bzhin bla ma de nyid las nā ro pa'i gur dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa gsum yan lag dang bcas pa/ yang bla ma de nyid la lo chen rin bzang nas brgyud pa'i dpal bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud slob dpon kaṃ ka na rgyal ba bzang po'i 'grel pa gsum dang*/ dkyil chog sgrub thabs bstod pa dang bcas pa gsan| de bzhin lo chen nas brgyud pa'i ngan song sbyong rgyud dang rab gnas yan lag bdun dang bcas pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs che chung*/ dpal nag po chen po la sogs pa'i man ngag du ma gsan no/ /de bzhin bla ma de las jo bo nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog dang*/ mi g.yo ba phyag rdor/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs| mdo kun las btus pa/

rigs tshogs lnga 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ bstod tshogs 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ de bzhin sman dpyad kyi gzhung du ma yang gsan no/ /de mtshungs bla ma pu rangs lo chung las bde mchog dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i skor/ gsang 'dus dang dus kyi 'khor lo'i yan lag dang bcas pa rnams kyang gsan no/ /yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rngog chen po las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa jo bo'i lugs dge bshes 'brom ston can na mgo ba zhes bya ba las nos pa'i nyi khri snang ba rtsa 'grel/ brgyad stong rtsa 'grel/ mngon rgyan rtsa 'grel/ sdud pa rtsa 'grel/ phyogs glang gi don bsdus rtsa 'grel/ shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs mang du gsan pa yin no/ /de'i rjes rje 'brog mi'i slob ma mkhar chung ba'i drung nas man ngag shin tu mang po gsan par mdzad/ de bzhin bla ma skyu ra a skyabs las kyang man ngag shin tu mang po gsan no// gzhan yang bha dra rā hū la zhes bya ba dang paṇ+ḍi ta dzñā na badz+ra sogs las gsan bsam mtha' yas pa mdzad/ dgung lo lnga bcu par gsung ngag bka' rgya thim pas skal ba dang ldan par bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang bas a seng sogs slob ma rnams la gsung ngag sogs gdams pa rgya mtshos 'tshims par mdzad nas snga phyir gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma khams pa rdor rgyal/ phag gru rdor rgyal/ byang chub sems dpa' stag siṅga gling gi a tsa ra/ sgom pa skyi 'bar/ zhu byas/ dga' ston rdo rje grags/ nag sgom bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ tshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa/ sgom pa 'od grags/ khams pa a seng*/ lho pa zhu byas/ klog skya jo sras chos grags/ gnyan phul chung ba/ gtsug tor rgyal po bsod nams rdo rje/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ lu phu ba bsod nams rin chen sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa mkha' mthar khyab par mdzad do/ /mthar dgung grangs re bdun pa sa pho stag

( spyi lo 1151 ) dbyug zla'i tshes bcu bzhi la byang phyogs 'od zer can ma'i zhing sogs su gshegs so// //gnas lnga rig pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo mchog ni yab sa chen dgung lo nga gcig pa rab byung gnyis pa'i chu pho khyi ( spyi lo 1142 ) lo la yum ma gcig 'od sgron gyi sras su dpal ldan sa skya'i chu mig rdzing kha'i gnas su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku bltams/ de'i tshe rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi sgo'i ya them la 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa mkhan po bsod nams rtse mo rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gi dbang phyug dam pa sa skyar skyes so zhes pa mkha' 'gro mas yi ger bris/ kau shaṃ bi'i paṇ+ḍi ta de ba ma tis phyogs thams cad du bsgrags pa las rim par brgyud de mthar bod na rtsad chod par grags so| |'di ni 'phags yul du paṇ+ḍi ta mi thub zla ba sogs paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bcu gcig tu rim par brgyud nas skye ba bzhes pa dran par gsungs/ dgung lo gsum bzhes pa'i tshe dpal kye rdo rje dang*/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang sgrol ma rnams dngon sum gzigs/ des na lo der kye rdor rgyud gsum/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kun las btus dang bcas pa lnga thogs med du thugs la gsungs/ yab bla chen las rdo rje theg pa'i dbang byin rlabs rgyud lung*/ man ngag phyag bzhes mtha' dag legs par gsan pas ma lus pa thugs su chud par mdzad/ mdor na dgung lo bcu drug tshun la yab la mnga' ba'i zab rgyas kyi chos tshul thams cad thugs la 'dris par mdzad/ dgung lo bcu bdun skabs yab zhi bar gshegs nas thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir chos 'khor chen po mdzad pa dang mtshungs gcung rje btsun rin po che dgung lo bcu gsum pa zhig la gdan sa gtad de dbus kyi gdan sa chen po drug gi ya gyal gsang phur phar tshad sogs nyan la 'ong gsungs nas gsang phur phywa pa chen po'i drung du phebs/

slob dpon chen po phywa pa las dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum dang*/ phar phyin sogs byams chos| mngon pa gong ma dang*/ rnam nges sogs tshad ma/ mdo rtsa sogs 'dul ba ste mdor na dam pa der yod pa'i yon tan thams cad la thugs 'dris par mdzad de/ jo sras bzhi las phul du byung ba zhig tu son no/ /de bzhin dgung lo nyer drug bzhes pa me mo phag gi lo la mnga' ris gung thang na la rtse gnas gsar gyi gtsug lag khang du chos la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes pa'i bstan bcos mdzad nas skyon med bstan rtsis kyi rnam gzhag gtan la phab par mdzad/ dgung lo nyer bdun skabs 'dzam bu gling pa'i bstan pa'i srog shing yin no zhes snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs mthar khyab/ dgung lo nyer brgyad skabs gzim khang rnying mar lam 'bras gsung pa'i skabs slob ma rnams la mthong snang mi 'dra ba gsum byung ba yin/ dam pa 'dis rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas ri bo gru 'dzin dang*/ lho phyogs dpal ri/ nub phyogs u ḍi ya na sogs su nyin phyed tsam gyis bskor bar mdzad nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam 'phrul du mar rol zhing rtse/ de bzhin slob dpon phywa pa gshegs pa'i tshe chos khri'i steng du sku 'bum bzhengs pa la rtse mor gser tog phul ba dang mtshungs slob dpon phywa pa'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i ras bris phyag bris su gnang ba la/ rdzas mdog ma 'dres so sor 'byed pa'i mig rtsa dmar po can/ /zhes pa'i bstod pa yang mdzad pas don du gser gyi gañdzir dang*/ yum rgyas pa sogs zang zing gi mchod pa du mas kyang thugs mnyes par mdzad/ de lta'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'di ni sngon gyi bag chags dang lhag pa'i lha de bzhin bla ma chen po'i drin gyis sgra dang*/ tshad ma/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i pha rol tu son pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur nas zab rgyas kyi chos skor rgyun mi chad par bskor bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du gsal bar mdzad pa la 'gran pa'i zla ba dang bral ba kho na yin/

de bzhin rtsod pa'i sgo nas bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul yang*/ mthar thug 'bras bu gcig tu grub pa la log par rtog pa dang*/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i theg pa chen po rnams don gcig la log par rtog pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i byung tshul la log par rtog pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul la log par rtog pa/ bka'i bsdu ba byas pa'i tshul la log par rtog pa/ tshe 'dir mthong lam thob kyang lus rgya ma zhig bar du yon tan mi 'byung bar 'dod pa'i log rtog sogs mdor na rgyal ba'i bstan par 'khrul pa smra ba mtha' dag dri ma med pa'i lung dang*/ dngos stobs kyi rigs pas sun phyung bar mdzad pa yin no/ /gsung rab brtsams pa'i sgo nas bstan par bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul ni 'og tu gsal/ gsung las skyes pa'i bstan 'dzin slob ma'i tshogs kyang rje btsun rin po che dang*/ zhu byas dngos grub/ rbon ston/ rje pa/ rmog ston pa/ jo sras lcags kyi rdo rje sogs byung la de rnams kyang rje sa chen gyi zhal slob phal cher slob dpon 'di'i slob mar gyur pa yin/ mdor na chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ gang gi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byin rlabs pas/ /gnas lnga la ni rab mkhas shing*/ /bsod nams ye shes rtser gyur pa/ /nyid kyi gzhan don rdzogs mdzad nas/ /'jig rten rnams ni bzhugs pa'i phyir/ /bde ba can du gshegs pa la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs| |zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mthar rtag 'dzin can rnams kyi log rtog sel phyir dgung grangs zhe gcig pa chu pho stag ( spyi lo 1182 ) smad zla'i tshes bcu gcig la las can dag pa'i snang ba la sku lus ma spangs par chu mig rdzing khar chos nyan gyi slob ma ka pā la thogs pa brgyad cu tsam gyi dbus su chos gsung 'phro la chos khri'i steng na sku nyid snang tshul tha dad du ma dang bcas te bde ba can du gshegs so// //de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i zlos gar rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan mchog ni yab sa chen dgung lo nga drug bzhes pa

( spyi lo 1147 ) rab byung gsum pa'i me yos lor yum ma gcig 'od sgron gyi sras su sku bltams/ dgung lo brgyad pa la byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan la tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa nod/ de nas bzung 'phral gyi kun spyod sogs kun dge slong las kyang lhag pa'i spyod pas bsrung bya rnams mig 'bras ltar gces par mdzad nas mchod pa'i skabs dam tshig rdzas tsam las sha chang sogs kyi dri tsam la'ang bsrung bya nan por mdzad nas dus dang rnam pa kun tu thugs dam la shin tu dam par mdzad la/ rgyun du phyag dper gzigs rtog gam gsung bshad mdzad pa las tha mal du bzhugs pa sus kyang mjal ma myong*/ dgung lo bcu gnyis skabs kye rdor rgyud gsum po ti gsol ba'i nyams mnal byung bas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid thugs su chud la de mtshungs 'khor slob rnams la brtag gnyis gsung bshad mdzad pas kun ngo mtshar gyi gnas su 'jog gnang mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gsum skabs gcen dbus su slob gnyer la gshegs pas rje btsun dgung lo chung ngu 'di lta bus dpal ldan sa skya'i gdan sa'i thugs 'gan bzhes/ bla mas gsung ngag lo dgu bkag rgya mdzad kyang lo bcu gsum bar dam rgya mdzad nas ma gsung*/ de mtshungs dgung lo nga drug skabs snye mo ru mtshams kyi gtsang khang dgon par mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po'i ngang las bla ma sa chen gyi ye shes kyi snang ba bstan te lam 'bras shin tu nye brgyud du bstsal/ de bzhin slob dpon rin po che bsod rtse dang*/ gnyan gtsug tor rgyal po/ zhang tshul khrims grags/ snyan dbang rgyal/ bal po dza ya se na/ lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan/ sum pa lo tsā ba dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje sogs las kye rdor rtsa bshad 'grel pa sgrub thabs kyi bshad srol thams cad dang*/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad srol rnams dang*/ bde mchog rtsa bshad yan lag dang bcas pa/ gsang 'dus lugs bzhi sogs dang*/

de nyid 'dus pa/ rdo rje rtse mo/ dpal mchog sbyong rgyud| gshin rje gshed dang mtshan brjod 'grel pa lugs drug yan lag dang bcas pa/ mi g.yo ba'i rtog chen/ gsang ba spyi rgyud/ dpung bzang*/ don zhags sogs kyi man ngag phra mo tshun chad la mkhas par mdzad/ de bzhin 'dul ba/ mngon pa/ dbu phar sogs kyi bshad srol yod pa rnams ma 'dres par sbyangs pas thugs 'dris par mdzad/ gzhan yang sgra tshad bzo gso sogs tha snyad nye mkho'i rig pa'i cha rnams kyang ji bzhin thugs kyi dpal du gtams par mdzad/ bshad pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis gdul bya'i pad tshal rnams la gang 'dul gyi snang ba sbyin par mdzad pa'i skabs su yang dka' gnad la sub sub dang byil byil po sogs kyi dri mas dben pa go bde la gnad zin pa nges pa bde blag tu 'byin pas bskyangs pa dang*/ rtsod pa zhugs chen gyi lces chos dang 'gal ba'i log pa rnams bsreg nas rgyu mtshan yang dag gi phyug pas blo ldan rnams smin par mdzad pa las 'khrungs pa'i slob brgyud phul du byung ba chos rje sa paṇa dang grags pa'i mtha' can brgyad ste/ kar shākya grags/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ nā ro ban+dhi gshin rje grags/ gsal ba dbang phyugs grags/ gras ston blo gros grags| dga' ston rdo rje grags/ lhe ston dkon mchog grags/ sa ston 'jigs med grags bcas dang*/ gur rgyan slob mar grags pa mu tshu byang chub grags dang*/ gtsang ston brtson 'grus grags/ lha thon yon tan gzung*/ rigs ldan shes rab rin chen bzhi dang*/ de bzhin jo sras lcags kyi rdo rje/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po/ rtsis 'dul gzhon nu seng ge khams kyi 'ji yon tan dge slong sogs byon no/ /gzhan yang bsam na mngon shes thogs pa med pa ste chos rje sa paṇa la phyis sog pos gdan 'dren par 'ong ngo zhes sogs dpag med mnga' la/ byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od ni shin tu brtas pa ste/

rgya gar du 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gsal zhing*/ rdzogs rim dang lhag bsam bral ba zhig tshe'i dus byas nas/ dbu dgu'i dod lba ba dgu brtsegs byas pa'i 'dre gdug pa can zhig tu skyes/ de nyid kha che paṇa chen bod la byon pa'i rjes la 'brangs te sus kyang bzlog ma nus pa'i tshe paṇa chen sa skyar phebs pa'i skabs su rje btsun gyis rdo dril bsnams nas bsu ba la byon/ 'gab 'brangs de mkhyen nas rdo dril nam mkhar bzhag nas bskrad pas rgya gar la'ang ldog ma nus par rgya nag tu song bas deng sang rgya nag kham che tsam gyi rjes la myul ba de'o gsungs/ de bzhin kha che paṇa chen gyis paṇa chung rnams la khong ni ma hā badz+ra dngos su 'dug gsungs la paṇa chen gyis gsang ba 'dus par dngos su gzigs| gzhan yang dngos po phyag tu gang byung ba rnams kyang chos phyogs kho nar gtong ba las 'du 'dzi'i yo langs kyi snang tshul spu tsam yang med/ mkhas pa'i tshul la gzigs na rgya bod kyi yig rigs kun la mkhas pas sbyong rgyud rgya dper gzigs pa dang*/ de bzhin gza' yum sogs 'ga' la 'gyur bcos kyang mdzad/ bod skad la ni bstan 'dzin slob brgyud dang*/ lhag par khong rang gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mdo sngags rig gnas kun tshogs pa las shes nus pa'o/ /rten la mtshon na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs rigs mi 'dra ba dang*/ bka' bstan bris sna tshogs pa glegs bam grangs med pa/ gdung rten sogs re re nas bgrangs ba las 'das pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher bsgrubs pa mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs bdun cu pa rab byung bzhi pa'i mes pho byi ba ( spyi lo 1216 ) la bde bar can du gshegs so// //phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta ni yab dpal chen 'od po dgung lo sum cu so gsum skabs yum nyi khri lcam zhes bya ba la bde ba dam pa dang bcas te rab byung gsum pa'i chu stag

( spyi lo 1182 ) khra zla'i tshes nyi shu drug la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang dang bcas te sku bltams/ 'di 'khrungs pa tsam nas gtam go rgyu med pa smra bas ma ma bde nas rje btsun chen por zhus pas saṃ skṛ ta'i skad smra bar gzigs nas khyed kyi bu skyon med gsungs/ gzhan yang phyag mdzub kyis nā ga ra dang lañtsha la sogs pa rgya gar gyi ā li kā li tshar re bris nas klog pa'i tshul mdzad/ slar de la mi 'gom par phyag gis phyis par mdzad/ rgya klog bod klog ma bslab par mkhyen te/ 'phags pas/ chos kyi ma mo ma bslab thugs su chud/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas yon tan thams cad rdzogs| |ces pa ltar ro/ /de bzhin rje btsun rin po che las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes nas mtshan kun dga' rgyal mtshan du gsol/ spyir 'phags pas/ skye ba skye ba rnams su yang dang yang*/ /mkhas pa mkhas pa'i tshogs la legs bsten nas/ /tshe 'dir las re zung re thos gyur pas/ /gzhung lugs kun shes kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /zhes dang*/ yang de nyid kyis/ mi nas mir gyur skye ba nyi shu lngar/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung gyur nas/ /bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad nang don rig /ces gsungs pa ltar lo grangs mang por sbyangs pas cung zad go rtogs rgyas pa ni mang po yod kyang rje btsun 'di ni dgung lo shin tu phra mo nyi shu la ma slebs gong nas paṇ+ḍi ta yi mtshan snyan don gyis khyab pa ste/ rol mo'i bstan bcos las paṇ+ḍi ta lo gzhon yang shes rab rgan pa zhes sogs las rtogs par nus so/ /dgung lo brgyad par sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ bcu pa la rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis thugs las gsungs la/ dgung lo bco brgyad par dpal ldan sa skya'i sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po'i rgyab a lce'i 'bum pa'i drung du slob dpon dbyin gnyen las dam pa'i chos mngon pa mdzod tshar gcig mnal lam du gsan par rmis pas mnal sad dus tshig don thams cad thugs su chud de mdzod kyi nye brgyud kyi bka' babs/

de bzhin phyogs glang phug pa yin zer ba'i phug pa gcig na tshad dpes bkang ste yod pa de'i lde mig gtad par rmis te tshad ma'i mnga' bdag chen por gyur/ bcu dgu par zhu ston rdo rje skyabs las byams pa'i chos sde chen po lnga rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa dang*/ dbu ma rigs tshogs sogs gsan pas gzhung lugs kun thugs su chud do/ /nyi shu par nyang stod rkyang 'dul bde ba can du tshun ston gzhon seng las tshad ma rnam nges kyis gtsos dbu tshad sogs mang du gsan/ de nas gtsang khro phur kha che paṇa chen gyi drung du byon te thog mar rnam 'grel gsan skabs paṇa chen gyis mchod brjod rgya skad du gsungs pa la/ chos rje 'dis bod dper gzigs nas slar rgya skad du bskyar te gsungs pas paṇa chen thugs dgyes nas khong dpon slob rnams kyi bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhes pa'i bsngags pa'i me tog phul/ gzhan yang sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa mngon 'dul bde mchog gsang 'dus dus 'khor cha lag dang sems 'grel skor gsum sogs mtha' yas pa gsan/ de mtshungs bal po saṃ gha shrī las sgra ka tsan dbyangs gsum dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod zlos gar la sogs pa gsan/ spyi lhas pa la bod du yod pa'i zhi byed rdzogs chen rim lnga nā ro ni gu gcod la sogs pa'i gdams pa rnams gsan| nyer bdun par nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du kha che paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos mkhan po/ spyi lhas pas las slob/ zhwa ston rdor skyabs kyis gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs bzhes te gong gi mtshan gyi mthar mkhan po'i mtshan gyi zur bsnan te kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ yang bram ze'i rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta su ga ta shrī las phyi rol pa'i rig byed bzhi gsan pa dang*/ lhag par rje btsun rin po che 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i zlos gar mkhan de tshe rabs skye ba'i bla ma yin pas 'go dge bsnyen bslab bya lnga nas mthar zab lam bla rnal bar gyis 'tshim par mdzad pa dang mtshungs ma 'ongs pa'i phrin las sogs gang 'ong rnams mngon shes kyis gtan la phabs par mdzad do/

/de ltar dgung lo so lnga bar khu bo la sogs pa mkhas pa rnams las mdo rgyud rig gnas kun gyis nying khus 'tshims par mdzad nas/ gangs can mkhas pa gzhan gyi spyod yul las 'das pa'i rigs pa can du rlom pa 'phrog byed 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rigs pas pham par mdzad de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gangs can gyi yul du'ang gzi 'od 'bar bar mdzad/ yang bod du de'i sngon brda sprod spyi dang de'i nang gses su gtogs pa rig gnas chung ba lnga ni skar rtsis tsam las gzhan snyan mngon sdeb zlos rnams kyi lugs srol khungs dang ldan pa deng gi bar smra bug kyi rgyan du 'dzin pa 'di yang skyes chen 'di yi bka' drin kho na yin/ de bzhin rnam 'grel gyi gzhung sa khyab rdo khyab tu dar ba 'di yang 'di yi drin yin par nges la rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos rnams la lung rigs kyi gnod pa yod med brtag nas khungs dang ldan pa'i gzhung bzang dgung du btegs/ rang bzos sgro btags kyi chos log tshul can rnams nyams smad par mdzad nas rgyal bstan rma bral dar ba yang 'di'i drin yin pa ni gang gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ de'i bshad rgyun du 'phel ba las rtogs nus so/ /'dir deng gi blun po 'gas tshig don gnyis tha dad du phye nas rang lugs bla mar bstod pa'i tshul du bsams nas tshig la mkhas pa sa paṇa zhes brjod pa de yang legs par soms dang*/ khyed kyi ngo la brda gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos srol 'byed par mdzad pa der bsams kyang*/ 'dis mdzad pa'i lam rim thub pa'i dgongs gsal dang 'jig rtain pa'i tshul dang tshul min 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad dang de bzhin rigs gter sdom gsum bdag med bstod 'grel sogs nang rig ston pa'i gzhung min par bsams nas bshad dam/ yang na de rnams kyis nang rig gi don legs par ston mi nus so snyam nas bshad/ dang po ltar na des nang rig gi brjod bya min pa'i don ci zhig ston rlom can khyod kyis brjod pa dus la bab bo/

/gnyis pa ltar na khyed cag kyi mgrin pa mthor btegs te thun min lta bur brjod pa de yang 'di las lhag pa'i don ston rgyu med pa ni mngon sum yin pas khyed nyid kyang de'i ra ba las ma 'das/ khyed cag gi gzhung kyang 'di bzhin yin na 'o na khyed ni smyon pa ltar dug shes bzhin du za ba de ci/ gzhan yang khyed ni byis pa ltar gzhan gyi lad mo zlo ba tsam las rang nyid la rnam dpyod med pa'ang shugs kyis ma grub bam/ gzhan yang rigs gter gzhung 'di bod nang phyogs 'dzin dug chus myos pas legs bshad du ma mthong yang*| 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab kyi spyan ldan rnams kyis legs bshad rin bral du gzigs nas rgya gar du bsgyur ba ni kun la grags shing grub pa'i gtam zhig yin pa de yang bsams par bya ba'i gnas so/ /des na thon mi sogs lo tsā ba rnams dang*/ mes dbon gsum sogs chos rgyal rnams ky-i drin la bsam shes byas nas lan bzang pos thugs bskangs 'dod med kyang*/ ngo tsha bral nas mi gtsang 'dam gyis ma sbag par mdzad rgyur smon lam zhu'o/ /de lta'i skyes chen 'dis bshad sgrub las gsum gyis bstan pa dang mi rigs gnyis ka bskyangs pa'i shul las bstan 'dzin dam pa'i slob brgyud kyang bgrangs ba las 'das pa zhig las gtso bor gyur pa ni/ rtogs pa'i rgyun 'dzin grub thob gnyis| |man ngag rgyun 'dzin lho dmar zung*/ /bshad rgyud 'dzin pa shar nub gung*| |grub pa'i rgyun 'dzin yang dgon pa/ /de bzhin rgyal mtshan mtha' can bdun| |phul byung lo tsā chen po bzhi/ /gtsang nag 'phags pa grags pa seng*// 'od shāka lha rje bi rje dang*/ /gcung po bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs/ /skyes bu rnams kyis bstan 'di gsal/ /mthar dgung grangs bdun cu bzhes pa rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags mo phag

( spyi lo 1251 ) smad zla'i tshes bcu bzhi la byang sprul pa'i sder sku yi bkod pa re zhig bsdu bar mdzad do// //'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che ni yab zangs tsha dang yum kun skyid gnyis la rab byung bzhi pa'i shing lug ( spyi lo 1234 ) la 'khrungs/ 'di ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge dhi zhes sdom brtson nyid/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal bar byed/ /ces pa'i lung bstan pa dang*/ de bzhin sa ston ri pa'i sku skyer yang dran/ dgung lo gsum par sgrub thabs mtsho skyes la sogs gsungs pas thams cad ya mtshan nas 'phags par mtshan gsol/ dgung lo bzhi par chos rje'i phyag phyir skyid grong du phebs/ brgyad pa la skyes rabs so bzhi thugs la gsungs/ dgu par brtag gnyis gsungs/ bcu par chos rje dang lhan du byang phyogs su phebs pa'i lam bar du lha sa'i jo bo'i drung du zul phu mkhan pos slob dpon mdzad nas skyor lung sher seng las dge tshul gyi bslab bya nod/ bcu bdun pa la chos rjer mnga' ba'i rgyu mtshan nyid dang 'bras bu gsang sngags/ phyi mo rig gnas sogs thugs su chud pas chos rje thugs dges nas lhung bzed dang chos dung sogs bstsal te slob tshogs dang bstan pa'i bya ba sems can gyi don bya ba'i dus la bab pas sngon gyi dam bca' dran par gyis shig ces gsungs| bcu dgur hor yul du phebs tī shrī'i mtshan gsol ba dang mtshungs bod khri skor bcu gsum dbang yon du phul/ nyer gcig la rgya hor yul gyi mtshams su mkhan po snye thang grags pa seng ge slob dpon jo gdan bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang dbus su bsnyen pa rdzogs/ slob dpon de dag las 'dul phar sogs rgya cher gsan/ nyer gsum par ldong ston ri bo rtse lngar gdan drangs nas gshin rje sogs chos sna mang po gsan/ de nas hor rgyal pho brang du phebs nas tha shang la bgyen zhes bya ba'i rjes su zhen pa'i lta ngan zin shing gi ston pa bcu bdun rigs pas pham par mdzad nas yang dag pa'i gnas la bkod/

sum cu par gdan sar phyag phebs nas gnyan 'od bsrungs| grub thob yon tan dpal/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ tshogs sgom pa/ glo bo lo tsā ba/ spyi bo lhas pa jo sras rnams las gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad| slar so gsum la rgya yul du phebs dbang yon du chol kha gsum phul nas bod khams gcig tu sa skya pas lugs gnyis kyis bde bas bskyangs/ de rjes bzhi bcu zhe gcig la gdan sar phyag phebs nas de'i skabs chu mig tu mchod ston rgya cher mdzad pas bcom ldan ral gri'i nga rgyal yang sngar rang rgyud rengs pa'i dbang du song snyam pa'i 'gyod pa dang bcas te phyag dang bshags pa grangs med phul nas bstod pa tshangs pa'i 'brug sgra zhes pa de phul/ dge tshul slong stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu'i mkhan po mdzad bstan 'dzin slob ma yang dharmā pā la| ye shes 'byung gnas/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dge slong kun blo/ dga' ldan bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ phyag na/ shes rab gzhon nu/ jin kim/ tī shri grags 'od sogs byung ngo*/ /mthar dgung lo zhe drug rab byung lnga pa'i lcags 'brug ( spyi lo 1280 ) lo'i mgo zla'i tshes nyi shu gnyis kyi snga dro dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad do// //thub dbang gangs kyi lhun po yi/ /dal babs dwangs bsil zab rgyas gsung*/ /rgyan drug la sogs klung chen nas/ /sa dkar sin dhu'i dbyibs su bskyil/ /de lta'i rin chen 'byung gnas rab g.yos las/ /zab gsang gsang chen nor bu ngogs gcig tu/ /spungs nas gdul bya'i dbul ba rnams bcil ba'i/ /kun dga'i ring lugs phrin las bsgrun pas dben/ / gsum pa de'i slob brgyud las chag lo dang*/ dpyal lo/ gnubs lo/ glo bo lo tsā ba/ zhang lo tsā ba/ shong yab sras/ lo mchog spang lo/ thar lo/ bu ston sogs byon la de mtshungs slar yang bstan pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i bla ma rnams las gsan pa rgya cher mdzad nas 'di'i slob brgyud las bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa kun rgyas pa ste/

shangs pa'i chos skor lta bu shin tu nya phra bar gyur dus mkhas pa 'di dang bla ma dpal ldan seng ges 'bad pa yod rgus lung khrid rgyun rnams g.yag chen por bstsal/ des kun mkhyen rong pa dang des kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la bstsal mkhas pa 'dis shangs pa'i chos skor bcu gnyis rnams legs par bsdus nas 'chad nyan bsgom pa'i rgyun spel bar mdzad pa'i drin gyis de'i slob brgyud mkhan chen ngag chos sogs las rgyas par mdzad pa dang*/ de bzhin bsnyen bsgrub yang bla ma dam pas bla grang rdzong chung bar bka' phabs/ des rdzong pa kun rgyal/ des kyang gtsang byams par bstsal la 'dis bsnyen bsgrub kyi chos skor bsdus nas de rnams kyi dkar chag bsgrigs pa sogs kyis 'dzin par mdzad/ de mtshungs sa bzang dang nyang dbon kun dpal sogs las sbyor drug dang*/ lo chen thugs rje dpal las bka' gdams man ngag brgyud pa rnams brgyud nas des rje dge 'dun sgrub par bka' phabs pa dang*/ yang skyabs mchog dpal las bka' gdams gzhung pa'i man ngag dang*/ rje red mda' ba las pa tshab dang khu'i lta ba| rje tsong kha pa chen po las dge ldan pa'am bka' gdams gsar ma/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa las rnying ma/ de bzhin chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims las ngor pa/ g.yag pa las byams chos dang tshad ma/ gzhan yang bu ston dang rgyal sras bla ma dam pa gsum ni phar slob tshur slob yin pas de rnams las kyang gzhung gdams ngag dang bcas pa'i rgyun sna tshogs dar la/ de bzhin lo chen byang rtse las/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de dang paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal las 'phel bar bo dong pa dang*/ yang spyan snga grags pa byang chub nas rje tsong kha par brgyud pa'ang ngo*/ /de bzhin karma rol pa'i rdo rje dang*/ gnyag phu ba bsod nams bzang po las sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyun 'dzin shin tu dar/ zhi byed la'ang kha che dzña na gu h+ya las dpang po chen por brgyud pa zhi byed sgrol ma'i skor gsum dang*/

gshin rje'i brgyud pa rnams kyang mkhas pa 'dir babs so// de'i slob brgyud du chos rje gzhung brgya pas sa rngog gi dgongs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu gsal bar mdzad la/ de las kyang gtso bo rngog gi rgyun shin tu nya phra bar gyur par ma bzod nas gzhung 'di'i rgyun cung zad lus pa de yang lugs 'di'i mdo la mkhas pa gsum gyi drin kho na yin no/ /de bzhin rje btsun zungs kyi dpa' ba dang*/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims gnyis las gtso bo ngor rdzong gnyis 'phel ba dang*/ lhag par rje btsun kun dga' bzang pos shin tu nya phra bar lus pa'i rgyud sde 'og ma gnyis la thugs ngal tshad med bskyangs pa dang*/ de mtshungs sde pa ya rgyab pa'i sras gangs can mig gcig thon mi sam bho ṭa'i rus brgyud rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis kyang gtso bo gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rma med pa dar ba mdzad pa sogs lugs 'di'i sngags la mkhas pa ngor rdzong tshar gsum las sngags bstan shin tu dar ba 'di dag go /lhag par mdo sngags rig gnas kun gzhi gcig tu btegs nas gang zag gcig gi rgyud la bstan pa'i rtsa ba mdo dang*/ bstan pa'i snying po gsang sngags/ bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan rig gnas rnams kyis yul gangs ljongs 'di 'dzam gling mi rigs khrod du sgeg pa'i gom stabs 'jog pa 'di yang lugs 'di'i mdo sngags rig gnas kun la mkhas pa'i skyes bu chen po rmad du byung ba'i lo tsā ba chen po bzhi dang mkhas pa chen po go shāka stag gsum gyis mdzad rjes las dar ba 'di dag go /de rjes snyigs dus bstan pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mkhyen brtse dbang po'i slob brgyud bka' drin bsgrun pas dben pa'i 'jam mgon kong sprul chen po dang 'ju chen mi pham rnam rgyal/ gtso bo gsang sngags gsar mar bka' drin che ba ngor thar rtse mkhan chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis sngar nas sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi brgyud pa'i dbang bka' sgrub thabs man ngag rnams kyi mtshan tho phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i dkar chag dbang rgyal nor bu'i phreng ba zhes yod pa de nyid gsang bdag blo gter dbang po la 'di rnams phyogs bsgrig bya dgos pa'i bka' lung bstsal ba rnams phyis rdzong gsar du rje mkhyen brtse'i spyan lam du phul bas shin tu thugs mnyes nas dbang bka' sogs bum pa gang byor bstsal/

de yang rje btsun mkhyen brtse dbang po ni thar rtse nam mkha' 'chi med kyi yang srid yin te/ de'i slob ma mkhan chen byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin yun ring 'dris pa'i mi bzhin ngo shes pa sogs thun min ngos 'dzin byung la/ des na ngor nas kyang zhabs drung go sa phul nas mtshan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du gsol/ de'i rjes paṇ+ḍi ta 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal las rig gnas/ smin gling mkhan chen rig 'dzin bzang po'i drung nas tshigs gsum rim gyis mnos/ sa skya pa 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ mkhan chen 'jam dpal bzang po/ rje blo gsal bstan skyong*/ de bzhin gzims 'og bstan 'dzin snyan grags las grags chen bco brgyad rnams gsan| li thang dge bshes byams pa phun tshogs las dge phyogs kyi chos skor rnams gsan/ gzhan yang thar rtse mkhan chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ zhe chen 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ rje 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu sogs las ris su ma chad pa'i gzhung la gsan bsam gnad du smin par mdzad nas/ bstan pa'i gzhi gang zag gcig gis 'degs nus pa'i dbang du mdzad nas bshad brgyud 'dzin pa'i bka' chen bcu dang*/ sngar thar rtse mkhan chen gyis lam srol yongs su rdzogs pa'i gdams ngag gi dbang du mdzad nas sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad ces gtan la phabs nas bstan pa'i shul rnams slob grwa'i gnas gcig nas len thub pa'i skal bzang bskrun pa 'di'o/ /de dang mtshungs 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos kong sprul rin po ches kyang bstan par gces spras mdzad pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig ni phyag rjes mdzod chen lnga sogs las shes par nus la mkhas chen de gnyis dang 'ju chen mi pham sogs kyi zhal slob gsang ba'i bdag po blo gter dbang po ni ngor mkhan chen byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las rab tu byung*/

de'i rjes slob dpon nam mkha' rgyal mtshan las bsnyen pa rdzogs nas mtshan blo gter dbang por gsol/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho/ 'jigs med dpal ldan/ rta nag pa mi pham seng ge rab rgyas| thub bstan chos kyi grags pa sogs yongs 'dzin bzhi bcu lhag la bsten nas gsar phyogs rgyud sde'i dbang bka' sum brgya bco lnga skor dang*/ lam 'bras sogs khrid chen nyer lnga/ zab khrid bka' srol brgya dang nyi shu/ rgyab rten bka' 'gyur dang*/ rgya bod bla ma kun gyi bka' 'bum sogs khyon pod bzhi brgya tsam/ rjes gnang skor stong phrag tsam dang*/ snga 'gyur dbang khrid lung cha tshang dang*/ sa skya'i grags chen bco brgyad bshad khrid sogs rgya mtsho lta bu'i thos pas thugs rangs par mdzad nas/ sngon gyi thar rtse mkhan chen bka' mngags mdzad pa dam du bzhed de rgyud sde kun btus khyon lo bco lnga la phal cher sgrub nas 'chad spel mdzad/ de mtshungs rje mkhyen brtse dang lhan du sgrub thabs kun btus pod bcu bsgrigs pa'i steng*/ slar rje btsun ko sprul mchog dang lhan du pod lnga bsgrigs bsnan mdzad/ gzhan yang lam 'bras slob bshad gsar rtsom dang bcas pod bdun phyogs bsdus mdzad tsam min par phyogs mtha' kun tu dar spel rgya cher mdzad pas sgrub brgyud kyis gtsos bstan pa rin po che rdo rje'i gnas la 'jog par mdzad pa 'di'o/ /de na 'dir rje btsun gong ma lnga slob brgyud dang bcas pa skabs su babs pas de las brtsams pa'i ngang tshul cung zad gleng ba yin la/ de mtshungs su mkhan slob chos gsum gtsos chos rgyal lo paṇa chen po rnams dang sprul pa'i rje 'bang nyer lnga sogs rnying mar grags pa rnams dang*/ jo 'brom legs gsum glang shar bya yul ba sogs bka' gdams pa'i skyes bu chen po rnams dang*/ smri ti rngog lo pa tshab sogs gzhung bshad spel ba'i dam pa rnams dang*/ ra 'bro 'brog 'gos gnyan sogs gsang sngags kyi chos skor spel ba rnams dang*/

lhag par sgrub brgyud bstan pa spel bar bsam zhing sprul bar mdzad pa'i skyes mchog mar pa dang de'i bshad brgyud 'dzin pa rngog dang mes ston pa la sogs pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin rje btsun chen po dang rje dwags po phag gru ba chen po nas che bzhi chung brgyad zur gnyis sogs dang*/ mkhas grub khyung po nas rmo'o lcog pa rin brtson dang dbon ston pa sogs kyi mdzad pa phrin las dang*/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mi yi zlos gar bdag nyid chen po blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs dang*/ rgyal tshab chos rje sogs 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad sogs kyi mdzad pa phrin las kun kyang gong brjod kyi yon tan dang gnyis su med pas skabs kyi brjod gzhir ma bsams par dug chen gyis zug rngus ma gtses par mdzad 'tshal lo/ /rnam thar de rnams thun mong la grags pa nyid gzhi bzung nas bris pa las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skor rnams ni spyod yul du'ang ma gyur la 'os pa yang ma mthong ste/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i skye rabs rnam thar rnams kyang gtso bo theg dman mdo sde las phyung nas gsungs pa yin la/ de bzhin rje btsun grags pas sa chen rnam thar dang*/ chos rjes rje btsun grags pa'i rnam thar/ mkhyen brtse dbang pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar rnams dang*/ lhag par kong sprul rin po ches gtam rgyud kyi sbyor ba 'chad skabs nges par du theg dman thun mong gi lugs bzhin bshad dgos/ zhes gsungs la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po ches kyang*/ dam pa gang gi rnam thar 'chad dus mkhyen brtse nus gsum dang dam pa'i tshul dgu'i yon tan ji yod las brtsams te 'chad dgos pa'i bka' slob gnang bas so// //bka' bstan man ngag chu 'dzin 'khrigs nas gsung dbyangs sbrang char ris su ma chad skal ldan zhing sa'i myu gu gzhon nu'i lang tsho'i dpal rab brtas mdzad pa/ /g.yo med spobs pa'i gangs rir gnas bcas 'jigs bral g.yu yi ral pas yongs gtams rgol ngan gya gyu'i bgros par rtsen rnams lung rigs mche sder rnon pos bcil/
